_comment: System-layer files that have been locally customized beyond upstream career-ops. update-system.mjs must NEVER blind-overwrite these on apply. Upstream versions are staged in .update-incoming/ for manual review/merge instead. Add a path here whenever you customize a file that is normally auto-updatable (see DATA_CONTRACT.md System Layer table). IMPORTANT: an entry only takes effect if it EXACTLY matches a SYSTEM_PATHS entry in update-system.mjs. For files under a path that SYSTEM_PATHS lists as a directory (docs/, templates/, plugins/, dashboard/, modes/de/, fonts/, .github/, .claude/skills/), you must override the WHOLE directory -- a per-file entry beneath it is ignored. VERSION is intentionally NOT overridden so the updater can advance the version marker.
